name: Doki Doki Silver & Emerald
storyline: Monika and Kotonoha make a bet to see who can get the best grade in an exam. Let's just say that Koto isn't very happy with the result and, well... you'll have to find out the rest.
summary: Doki Doki Silver & Emerald is a short mod for Doki Doki Literature Club, created by Tiny Waffle Studios. Released on February 10, 2024, the mod combines elements of comedy and drama. In the story, Monika and Kotonoha make a bet to see who can get the best grade in an exam in the next class. Kotonoha gets a bit annoyed, and events unfold from there. This mod also offers a closure to what Natsuki mentioned at the end of “Natsuki Rants About DDLC Mods and Community”.
